General Waste

L A B O R A T O R Y 1 W O R K S H E E T
NAME
Cleaning and Disinfection of Biohazardous Materials
4.	 You notice a small amount of blood on the table that your absorbent laboratory mat did 
not catch. How do you proceed in cleaning and disinfection of this area?  
 
Note: In your response, be sure to also include all materials you would need to do the job 
and how the materials are handled when you are done.
